# Account Support

## Creating an Account

Customers can create an account by providing their email address and choosing a secure password. The email address should be valid and accessible because it may be required for account verification.

## Account Verification

If an account requires verification, customers should check their email for the verification message. They should also check their spam or junk folder if the message is not visible in the inbox.

## Change Account Email

Customers who need to change the email associated with their account should contact customer support. Support may request account information to verify ownership before making the change.

## Account Locked

## Close an Account

Customers who want to close their account should contact customer support. Account closure may be permanent, so customers should confirm that they no longer need the account before requesting closure.

# Billing Support

## Billing Cycle

Customers are charged according to their selected billing plan. The billing date may vary depending on when the subscription was started.

## Unexpected Charge

If a customer notices an unexpected charge, they should review their billing history and verify whether the charge is related to an active subscription or recent purchase.

If the charge cannot be identified, the customer should contact support with the transaction details.

## Duplicate Charge

If a customer believes they were charged twice for the same transaction, they should check their payment history first. If two completed charges are present for the same purchase, they should contact support with the transaction details.

## Billing Information

Customers who need to update their billing information should use the billing settings available in their account. If they cannot update the information, they should contact customer support.

## Subscription Renewal

Subscriptions may renew automatically according to the customer's selected plan. Customers should review their subscription sett

## Billing Dispute

Customers who believe a billing charge is incorrect should contact customer support and provide the relevant transaction information so the issue can be investigated.

# Payment Support

## Payment Failed

If a payment fails, customers should verify that their payment method has sufficient funds and that the billing information is correct.

Customers can try the payment again after checking their payment details. If the payment continues to fail, they should contact customer support.

## Payment Declined

A payment may be declined by the payment provider because of insufficient funds, incorrect payment information, or security restrictions.

## Payment Reversed

## Card Payment

If a card payment fails, customers should verify the card number, expiration date, security code, billing information, and available funds.

# Refund Support

## Refund Eligibility

Refund eligibility depends on the type of purchase and the applicable refund policy. Customers should contact support if they are unsure whether a purchase qualifies for a refund.

## Request a Refund

Customers who want to request a refund should contact customer support and provide the relevant order or transaction details.

Support will review the request and determine whether the transaction qualifies for a refund.

## Refund Processing

After a refund is approved, the processing time may depend on the payment method and financial institution.

Customers should allow the required processing time before contacting support about a missing refund.

## Refund Not Received

## Partial Refund

A partial refund may be issued when only part of an order or service qualifies for a refund.

Customers should contact support if they believe the refunded amount is incorrect.

## Cancelled Order Refund

If an order is cancelled and qualifies for a refund, the refund will be processed according to the applicable refund policy.

Customers should retain their order information until the refund has been completed.

## Refund Status

Customers can contact support to check the status of a refund. They should provide the relevant order or transaction information so the request can be located.

# Returns Support

## Return Eligibility

Customers may be able to return eligible products according to the applicable return policy.

Return eligibility may depend on the product, purchase date, and condition of the item.

## Start a Return

Customers who want to return a product should contact customer support or use the available return process.

They should provide the relevant order information when requesting a return.

## Return Condition

## Return Condition

Returned products may need to be in an acceptable condition and may need to include the original accessories or packaging.

Customers should review the applicable return requirements before sending an item back.

## Return Shipping

Return shipping instructions depend on the order and the applicable return policy.

Customers should follow the provided return instructions and use the recommended shipping method when required.

They should provide their order or return information so support can locate the request.

## Damaged Product

If a product arrives damaged, customers should contact support as soon as possible and provide the order information and details about the damage.

Photos or other evidence may be requested during the investigation.

## Wrong Product Received

If a customer receives an incorrect product, they should contact support with their order information and explain the issue.

Support will provide instructions for returning the incorrect item and resolving the order.

## Exchange

If an exchange is available for the product, customers should contact support to confirm eligibility and receive the appropriate instructions.

# Technical Support

## Internet Connection Problems

If a customer is experiencing internet connection problems, they should first check whether the issue affects only one device or multiple devices.

Customers can restart their network equipment and check that all cables and connections are secure.

If the problem continues, they should contact technical support with details about the issue.

If the issue remains unresolved, they should contact technical support with information about the device and problem.

Customers who suspect unauthorized access or suspicious activity should secure their account and contact customer support immediately.

Customers should never share passwords or other sensitive credentials with support agents.
